tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Withdraws a pending request of the customer when the customer asks for it, the same as the link in the e-mail from Bookvia. request_id comes from request_quote or list_my_requests. Bookvia tells the business by e-mail; an urgent request is withdrawn at every business that has not answered yet. Error

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_businesses" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
